title: range42 bundle parameters (source annotation)
description: Shape of a hand-authored bundle_parameters.src.yml. The generator validates every source against this and refuses to emit JSON for a malformed one. Descriptive contract: the backend keeps its own input validation.

bundle.description: free-form bundle path 'tier/name'; the tier (first segment) is NOT a closed set. ctf may be deeper, e.g. ctf/cve/web/apache/CVE-...

optional.description: true if the bundle can be toggled on/off in a scenario (has an INSTALL_ flag at the call-site); false = always runs when imported

install_flag.description: required iff optional=true; the scenario when: flag that enables it (e.g. INSTALL_WAZUH)

target.description: true on the single param that feeds the play `hosts:` (the run target). UI renders a group/host picker, not a value field. Canonical name (Phase 2): TARGET_ANSIBLE_HOSTS. Omit for value params.

renamed_to.description: internal/role var(s) the caller name maps to; a list because one caller var can fan out

default.description: effective default; usually omitted for default_where=role-defaults (the generator resolves it from the role)

allowed.description: closed enum of permitted values as STRINGS (present|absent, YES|NO, ...) -> UI renders a dropdown. items:string also rejects unquoted YAML booleans (bare YES/NO parse to true/false).

from_vault.description: value is resolved from the scenario vault at runtime (key = vault_key or name); never stored in the json, never rendered by the UI

vault_key.description: vault key to read when from_vault=true, if it differs from name
